verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a laptop processor platform has documented I/O such as PCIe lanes, storage support and Thunderbolt/USB. The evidence pack, however, is mostly AI, gaming and battery marketing. Its only connectivity item is a one-line Bluetooth 6 claim, which is a wireless feature rather than the PCIe, storage or dock-connectivity specs the story asks for, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform has documented I/O headroom — PCIe generation and lanes, fast storage, and external connectivity specs I can plan a build or dock setup around
